topic: Bacteria vs human cell count: 38 trillion vs 30 trillion, colon, 200 g
hook: Bacteria outnumber your own body's cells
caption:
You may have heard that bacteria outnumber your cells 10 to 1. That old number was a rough guess from the 1970s. A 2016 recount found about 38 trillion bacteria and 30 trillion human cells, so it's closer to 1.3 to 1.

Almost all of them live in your colon, and together they weigh only about 200 grams. Part 2 tomorrow: what those bacteria actually do for you. Follow so you don't miss it.

Did you grow up hearing the 10 to 1 myth? 👇
